# Betclic & GrowthBook Technical Demo
Date: 2026-11-03 | Duration: 65.62999725341797m

## Summary
Betclic’s GrowthBook evaluation is nearing final review, with the RFP response expected within the week or at the beginning of next month and a solution decision targeted by year-end. The team identified manual experiment tracking, fragmented A/B testing tools, limited conflict visibility, and dependence on engineering and data teams as key challenges. GrowthBook proposed a unified platform for mobile, web, and server-side experimentation, with Snowflake-native analysis, reusable metrics, templates, self-service workflows, feature flags, controlled rollouts, and flexible targeting. Betclic still needs deeper validation of identity mapping, exposure attribution, gaming-revenue events, stopping rules, statistical methodology, and monitoring. GrowthBook can operate alongside existing feature-management infrastructure and use read-only Snowflake access. Immediate next steps include completing the RFP, providing pricing information, exchanging sizing questions, and arranging a data-science follow-up involving GrowthBook’s lead and Betclic’s lead analyst.

## Keywords
Experimentation platform, Snowflake analytics, Feature flags, A/B testing, Statistical attribution, Experiment governance
